forms.derivation: Chief of staff, the only claimed public face: a command spire (octahedron) with an orbiting command ring for the 9 departments it orchestrates. Signal amber = CWI brand authority.
The scout — 'ear-first, blunt, allergic to hype': a sharp needle cone (blunt verdicts) beside a tilted ear-dish torus (ear-first listening). Phosphor green = go/no-go signal.
The showrunner — 'every release is an event': a marquee arch (half-torus) ringed with radiating light bars. Warm red = showtime.
The closer — 'nothing ships uncleared': a seal stamp (cylinder) locked with an interlocking ring (the closed deal). Violet = royalty/deal ink.
The DJ — 'lives on rotation': a turntable platter (cylinder) with a rotating tone arm. Glow blue = airwaves.
The wire chief — 'every claim carries its citation': a transmission mast with expanding signal rings (the wire). Teal = newsroom ticker.
The craftsperson — house style neon/cyberpunk, makes things beautiful: a fader console (box) with a sliding knob (the mix). Orange = studio warmth.
The quant — 'no number without a source': a crystalline icosahedron lattice (wireframe) around a solid core (the verified fact). Ice blue = precision.
The guardian — 'reads the fine print': a protective dome over a charter scroll (partial cylinder). Parchment gold = documents.
The closer of outcomes — result → mechanism → verification → kill rule: a receipt spike filing stacked receipt discs. Paper white; core glows phosphor green when executing.

links.co_activity: both agents hold in_progress tasks in the same snapshot
links.name_reference: one agent's task title names another agent (handle or public name)
links.note: Link pulses are drawn ONLY from task data in the same snapshot.

note: Form Spec for the Agent Stage. Each agent's 3D form is generated FROM its department identity — never picked from a stock avatar set. The scene (index.html, AGENT STAGE section) reads this file as data and builds every form from it. Full derivation of each choice lives in FORMS.md.

states.DORMANT: presence not online, or heartbeat older than 30 minutes → dimmed, minimal motion
states.EXECUTING: agent holds a live task with state in_progress → focused motion, bright core, stable geometry
states.SAMPLE: no live data (SAMPLE pill) → neutral dim expression, labeled as sample
states.THINKING: agent's current_task_id changed since the previous snapshot → slower pulse
states.WAITING: presence online, no live task → low-energy drift, dimmed core
states.note: Operational state is derived ONLY from live-data.json at each refresh. Never emotions, never invented.
